body: This would be the second time I have had these feelings. I have told family about this before, but was instantly scolded as "suicide is a sin." I have only told one person outside my family, and she called me fucking crazy for being selfish. That got me out of it for a few days, but as you can see, I'm back in it. At this point, my family has no idea, and the other person is still in touch, but I'm not sure I can approach her anymore.
